project_info.theme: Original astronomy-book-inspired fashion magazine page with a navy-and-gold portrait
project_info.creative_direction: High-fashion cutout portrait integrated into a refined scientific reading spread with fictional pseudo-text
project_info.color_palette: off-white paper, navy knitwear and tights, muted red drop-cap, gold stars, ink black, and soft neutral skin tones

main_subject.type: clearly adult woman matching the approved face reference
main_subject.detail: same adult woman as the reference image, natural skin texture, preserved facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, moles, freckles, and hairline
main_subject.wardrobe: navy knit sweater with slightly oversized sleeves, tailored navy mini skirt, navy tights with evenly spaced glossy gold star pattern, and elegant navy high-heeled ankle boots
main_subject.pose: calm direct gaze toward camera, hands gently stacked under chin, legs crossed naturally while seated on a simple black stool

composition_elements.framing: 9:16 vertical magazine layout with the subject slightly lower-middle and overlapping two justified text columns
composition_elements.background: off-white astronomy book-page texture with non-readable serif pseudo-text and a large muted red drop-cap at top left
composition_elements.illustrations: thin ink-style telescope, Saturn, spiral galaxies, star clusters, constellation dot-and-line diagrams, and tiny starbursts embedded in margins
composition_elements.typography: academically authentic spacing, justification, and hyphenation patterns with no real words, book excerpts, title, author, citations, logos, or watermark

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft editorial key at approximately 5000K with subtle neutral rim light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: clean cutout edge, realistic contact shadow, natural skin rendering, delicate gold-star sheen, and quiet cosmic atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 50mm lens, high-end editorial cutout composite
technical_specs.finish: crisp but natural, subtle 35mm grain, natural dynamic range, restrained color, and realistic fabric texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an original high-fashion editorial magazine page inspired by classic astronomy and science-book design, without copying any real book title or text. Use an off-white paper texture resembling a refined astronomy page, filled with two tall justified columns of non-readable serif pseudo-text and a large muted red drop-cap at the top left. Embed small precise hand-drawn scientific illustrations: a telescope sketch, Saturn with rings, spiral galaxies, star clusters, constellation dot-and-line diagrams, and tiny starbursts within margins and between columns. In front, place a clean cutout-style photoreal portrait of the same clearly adult woman whose approved face reference must be matched exactly, seated on a simple black stool with realistic contact shadow. Dress her in a navy knit sweater, navy tailored mini skirt, navy tights with evenly spaced glossy gold star patterns, and elegant navy high-heeled ankle boots. Add subtle gold and silver micro-star makeup near the outer eye corners, a calm direct gaze, hands stacked under the chin, and naturally crossed legs. Use a 9:16 vertical composition, clean paste-up edge, high-end editorial photography, subtle 35mm grain, and no readable real text, logos, or watermarks.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, different face, altered facial features, age shift, celebrity likeness, readable text, real book excerpt, real title, author name, citations, logos, watermarks, plastic skin, over-smoothing, over-saturated, HDR, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken gold-star pattern, distorted clothing
